from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialFiling(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial snapshot from a 10-Q report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period, typically YYYY-MM")
    
    # Total Assets
    total_assets_value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Assets")
    total_assets_unit: str = Field(description="The unit of the Assets value (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")
    
    # Total Equity
    total_equity_value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Stockholders' Equity")
    total_equity_unit: str = Field(description="The unit of the Equity value (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")
    
    # Retained Earnings
    retained_earnings_value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of Retained Earnings (negative if Deficit)")
    retained_earnings_unit: str = Field(description="The unit of the Retained Earnings value (e.g., 'million', 'thousand')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[FinancialFiling]
